claimPolicy: All C claims below are documentary, checked by research-space-manager on 2026-10-22, not hands-on tests. Source references resolve to exact URLs above; excerpts preserve vendor claims without adopting safety/performance guarantees. BR claims explicitly reuse 2026-10-21 register. Unknown is not No.

claims.wording: Pangalin Space Manager is the official product name; homepage is pangalin.com/space-manager/.
claims.excerpt: Pangalin Space Manager

claims.wording: Pangolin Space Manager is a search-spelling alias, not another product.
claims.excerpt: if you searched for “Pangolin Space Manager”, you're in the right place. It's the same app from the same two brothers.

claims.wording: Requires Apple silicon M1 or later and macOS 13 Ventura or later; does not run on Intel Macs.
claims.excerpt: A Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later) running macOS 13 Ventura or later. Pangalin Space Manager doesn't run on Intel Macs.

claims.wording: Homepage What's new identifies 3.51.0; this is a documented version, not an installed or newest-binary certification.
claims.excerpt: 3.51.0: Free Up Space finds build and dependency folders for many more languages

claims.wording: Scanning has no account or time limit. The free space allowance is 5 GB total per Mac, shared across space-freeing actions, not monthly or reset by reinstalling.
claims.excerpt: It's a one-off allowance for each Mac, not a monthly one, and reinstalling the app doesn't reset it.

claims.wording: Advertised licence is US$25/year excluding applicable tax, automatically renewing every 12 months at then-current price; covers every Mac personally owned or controlled. Cancellation stops future renewals; paid features continue through paid period. Purchase and renewal refunds are offered within 14 days.
claims.excerpt: Prices: Pangalin Space Manager $25 a year, in US dollars. / prices exclude tax. / subscriptions renew automatically every 12 months at the then-current price / the licence is personal to you and covers every Mac you personally own or control
claims.conditions: Advertised terms only; no checkout, payment, cancellation or refund tested; mandatory local consumer rights may add exceptions (EULA A13).

claims.wording: Snapshot deletion, Janitors cleanup commands, startup-item disabling/removal and automatic moves without asking require a subscription, even when free allowance remains.
claims.excerpt: Deleting local snapshots and running other tools' clean-up commands need a licence / so do switching off or removing startup items and letting automatic moves run without asking.

claims.wording: Vendor documents local scans and files; Explain uses on-device Apple Intelligence, not a hosted assistant.
claims.excerpt: Written on your Mac. Explanations use Apple's on-device model (Apple Intelligence). They are never sent to us, and our apps don't use Apple's cloud model or any other AI service.
claims.conditions: Vendor statement, not network audit; update check and optional network actions exist.

claims.wording: Explain requires Apple silicon, macOS 26 and Apple Intelligence enabled; three answers per Mac free, unlimited with licence. Answers may be imperfect.
claims.excerpt: It needs Apple silicon, macOS 26 and Apple Intelligence turned on; where it can't run, the button doesn't appear. You get 3 free answers per Mac, unlimited with a licence.

claims.wording: Vendor documents reviewed cleanup and verified external-drive moves with a shortcut left at the original path and Reinstate in History.
claims.excerpt: copies them to an external drive, checks every file, then leaves a shortcut in the old place so apps still find them while the drive is plugged in. Every move can be put back from History.

claims.wording: A move is not a backup; the drive must be connected to use moved data. Vendor recommends quitting the owning app. Managed Photos/Music/app libraries use their own app-specific routes rather than bulk moves.
claims.excerpt: A move is not a backup. After the move, the external drive holds the only copy. / Libraries managed by an app, such as Photos, Music, Logic Pro sound content or Ableton Packs, must be moved by that app

claims.wording: Vendor says normal removals use Trash, but caches clear directly and snapshot deletion, emptying Trash and other labeled actions can be permanent. Automatic moves are optional, off initially, and may run without a per-run review when explicitly enabled with a licence.
claims.excerpt: Caches are cleared directly / Automatic moves are optional and off until you switch them on / unless you choose Move without asking (needs a licence)

claims.wording: Space Watch, menu bar, History, Never Clean, Preview only and System Data views are advertised free. Forecast and what changed documents growth this week; do not claim monitoring is absent.
claims.excerpt: Forecast and what changed / What grew this week, and roughly when your disk would fill at that rate. / Free

claims.wording: Janitors run other tools' cleanup commands; 3.51.0 notes build/dependency folders and new Composer, Deno, Dart/Flutter and pre-commit Janitors.
claims.excerpt: four new Janitors run the clean-up commands built into Composer, Deno, Dart and Flutter, and pre-commit
claims.conditions: No runtime/tool compatibility testing; do not imply all adapters work on all installations.

claims.wording: Vendor advertises Apple notarization and optional Full Disk Access; scans without that permission can under-report protected areas.
claims.excerpt: Notarised by Apple / Without it, Pangalin Space Manager still works but under-reports those areas.
claims.conditions: Vendor disclosure only; no binary signature inspection. No instructions to bypass protections.

claims.wording: Software is offered under a proprietary personal non-transferable EULA, not an established open-source licence.
claims.excerpt: We grant you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence / We own the apps and all rights in them. You get a licence to use them, not ownership.

claims.wording: Pangalin Uninstaller is a distinct same-vendor sibling, not an alias for Space Manager.
claims.excerpt: Pangalin Uninstaller is completely free. Pangalin Space Manager's paid subscription adds features, unlocked with a licence key.

claims.wording: Vendor documents APFS duplicate merging that keeps each path, rather than deleting extra named copies.
claims.excerpt: lets them share one set of storage on the disk (an APFS clone). Every copy stays where it is with its own name

claims.wording: App/helper CPU and memory grouping comparable to Breathing Room: not verified.

Breathing Room is a free Apache-2.0 macOS preview with source implementations for storage views, app/helper CPU/memory grouping and activity observations; source presence does not prove distributed-binary parity.
claims.excerpt: Breathing Room is a free, Apache-2.0 macOS maintenance preview / Source implementation is not proof that every feature works in the distributed installer.

claims.excerpt: Apple Development signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized / Python 3.10+ / Physical Intel behavior remains explicitly untested.

claims.wording: Local inspection/manual tools and CPU/memory monitoring are advertised free; AI Care US$5/month or US$50/year renews until cancelled, tax at checkout. Hosted AI requires internet/authentication and may send paths/process/storage data; not all-local AI.
claims.excerpt: Confirmed advertised $5 USD/month, $50 USD/year. / Hosted AI assistance requires internet access and authentication
claims.conditions: No paid allowance, unlimited-use, activation or backend enforcement claim; not newly re-fetched.

claims.wording: Breathing Room source includes exact-action review and saved daily approvals while running, with an explicitly optional automatic verified-Ruff-cache mode; do not claim unconditional approval before every deletion.

workflow.title: Move Mac data to an external drive with a return plan
workflow.primaryIntent: Decide what can be relocated rather than deleted, and plan for a missing drive and restoration.
workflow.leadDirection: Relocating reusable models or other data is different from deleting disposable caches. A move is not a backup; keep the owning app and drive dependency in view.
sections: Choose keep, rebuild or relocate before acting
Space Manager's documented copy/check/link and review workflow
Managed libraries need their owning app's route
Plan for unplugged drives, independent backup and History Reinstate
When investigation is more useful than relocation
workflow.interactionHandoff: Non-executing decision checklist: must retain data? owning app supports move? backup exists? drive remains connected? enough room to return? No filesystem access or invented calculator savings.
workflow.visualPlan: After lead use cleared official Move to External view; later show Breathing Room Space example-data preview for investigation context. Both image gates must pass first.
workflow.forbidden: No relocation executed; no step may be framed as tested. Do not claim Breathing Room implements Space Manager's external-drive/link/History workflow.

comparison.title: Breathing Room vs Pangalin Space Manager
comparison.primaryIntent: Choose a Mac storage workflow: documented relocation and local explanations versus preview storage/activity investigation and optional hosted care.
comparison.shape: Concise answer, sourced matrix keyed above, three decision criteria, installation/privacy/price caveats, link to workflow article and comparisons hub.
comparison.recommendationBoundary: No blanket winner, safety/speed ranking or savings estimate; no unsupported negative competitor cells.

spaceManager: Documented verified external-drive moves and History return route, APFS duplicate merging and local Apple Intelligence Explain (C08-C11,C18). These are vendor-documented, not our measurements.
Space Watch and growth forecast are documented; no claim it lacks recurring monitoring (C13).
Apple silicon only; Explain additionally needs macOS 26/Apple Intelligence. Free allowance is lifetime-per-Mac, not monthly; some operations paid immediately (C03,C05,C07,C09).
Moved files depend on the external drive and separate backup. Not every action is reversible; automatic moves can be explicitly authorized without asking (C11,C12).
breathingRoom: Potential fit for readers investigating app/helper CPU/memory and sampled activity alongside storage, based on current source evidence (BR01). Do not turn unverified competitor grouping into an absence claim.
Free local inspection and optional hosted care are different from Space Manager's local Explain; hosted data/authentication and price boundaries must remain visible (BR03).
Preview signing/notarization, Python prerequisite and incomplete installer/Intel validation are material trade-offs, not fine print (BR02).
No equivalent relocation/duplicate-merge promise established in this research. Do not imply identical feature coverage.
